features.name: Metal map view
features.scope: Map renders through drape's Metal backend in an NSView backed by CAMetalLayer, Retina-correct, survives resize and moving between displays.
features.accept: Resize the window and drag it between a Retina and non-Retina display: the map stays sharp, with no blank frames or crashes.
features.notes: Single main window and quit-on-close prevent the second engine and the use-after-free (7b587a6, R-B1). Still open: rendering isn't paused when hidden (R-B8); on-map widgets keep the old scale after a display change (R-B9); app-lifetime engine owner (T-054).

features.name: Pan and zoom
features.scope: Trackpad: two-finger scroll pans, pinch zooms. Mouse: wheel zooms around the cursor, click-drag pans. Cmd +/- zoom.
features.accept: With a plain mouse, the wheel zooms in and out around the pointer. With a trackpad, two-finger scroll pans.
features.notes: Mouse wheel zooms around the pointer (b4f7867); acceptance check not run yet.

features.name: Map rotation
features.scope: Trackpad twist rotates. Mouse: right-drag or Option-drag rotates.
features.accept: Rotate the map with a mouse only, then reset with Orient North.
features.notes: Only trackpad rotate works; mouse users can't rotate.

features.name: Orient north
features.scope: Menu item and shortcut (Cmd-Shift-N) reset rotation; clicking the compass does the same.
features.accept: Rotate, press the shortcut, map snaps north; click compass, same result.
features.notes: Menu item has no shortcut; compass click unverified.

features.name: Scale ruler
features.scope: Engine ruler widget, respects measurement units.
features.accept: Switch units in Settings: ruler changes between km and mi.

features.name: Map layers
features.scope: Toolbar menu toggles subway, isolines, outdoor, hiking, cycling. Each has a View-menu shortcut.
features.accept: Toggle each layer from the menu and by shortcut; state matches in both places.
features.notes: No keyboard shortcuts for layers.

features.name: 3D buildings
features.scope: Single toggle shared by toolbar and Settings.
features.accept: Toggle in the toolbar, open Settings: the switch shows the same state.
features.notes: Toolbar and Settings keep separate state and can disagree.

features.name: Map style and appearance
features.scope: Map style (default/outdoors/vehicle) plus Light/Dark/System appearance; System follows macOS appearance changes live.
features.accept: Set System, flip macOS to Dark: map switches to dark style without restart.
features.notes: No System option; map ignores macOS appearance; Outdoor layer and style picker can conflict.

features.name: My location
features.scope: CoreLocation position marker, follow mode, Cmd-L. Denied permission shows an explanation.
features.accept: Deny location, press Cmd-L: a message explains how to enable it.
features.notes: A denied permission leaves the engine stuck in pending-position mode with no message (R-B14).

features.name: Point on map (what's here)
features.scope: Right-click anywhere opens a menu: What's here, Add bookmark, Route from/to/via, Copy coordinates.
features.accept: Right-click an empty spot and add it as a route stop.
features.notes: Only reachable by press-and-hold; no context menu.

features.name: Perspective / 3D tilt
features.scope: Not offered on desktop.
features.notes: Decision D-03.

features.name: Maps manager
features.scope: Download Maps window (Shift-Cmd-D): region tree, search, sizes, download/update/delete/cancel/retry.
features.accept: Download a small country, cancel one mid-way, retry it, delete it.

features.name: On-demand download prompt
features.scope: Banner when the viewport is over an undownloaded region; Shift-Return downloads.
features.accept: Pan to an undownloaded country: banner appears with size; download completes and map fills in.

features.name: Downloaded maps cleanup
features.scope: Downloaded tab with count and total size; delete per region.
features.accept: Delete a downloaded region from the Downloaded tab; total size updates.
features.notes: No multi-select delete.

features.name: Map data updates
features.scope: Shows when a newer map version is available and updates all in one action.
features.accept: With outdated maps, Update All downloads new versions and the old ones are removed.
features.notes: Per-region update exists; no Update All or version notice verified.

features.name: Offline search
features.scope: Cmd-F search across downloaded maps; results list plus map pins.
features.accept: Search a street name in a downloaded city offline: results appear and pins show on the map.
features.notes: Turning live pins off doesn't stop them; they return on the next pan (R-B5).

features.name: Category search
features.scope: Category chips with localized labels.
features.accept: Category chips show readable, localized names (e.g. 'Cafe', not 'cafe').
features.notes: Labels are title-cased keys, not localized.

features.name: Search refinements
features.scope: Open-now and cuisine filters on results.
features.accept: Search 'restaurant', filter open now: closed places disappear.
features.notes: Engine IsOpenNow not bridged.

features.name: Coordinate jump
features.scope: Typing lat/lon in common notations centers the map.
features.accept: Type '47.37, 8.54' and select the result: map centers on Zurich.

features.name: Search history
features.scope: History tab with clear.
features.accept: Run two searches, reopen search: both are listed; Clear empties the list.

features.name: Place inspector
features.scope: Clicking a POI opens an inspector with name, type, address, coordinates, details, routing buttons.
features.accept: Click a shop: inspector shows its details; Cmd-I hides and shows the pane.
features.notes: Bookmarks, route stops and share links use the click point, not the place's coordinate (R-B6).

features.name: Contact links
features.scope: Phone, website and email open in the default app.
features.accept: Click a website in the inspector: it opens in the browser.
features.notes: Shown as selectable text only.

features.name: Opening hours
features.scope: Formatted weekly hours with open/closed now.
features.accept: A shop with hours shows a readable table and its current state.
features.notes: Raw OSM string shown.

features.name: Wikipedia description
features.scope: Excerpt and link when the feature has a Wikipedia tag.
features.accept: Click a landmark with Wikipedia data: excerpt and link appear.
features.notes: Only the raw tag is shown.

features.name: Share location
features.scope: Copy a web link (https://omaps.app/...) and open the macOS share sheet.
features.accept: Copy link for a place, paste in a browser: it opens that place.
features.notes: Copies the om:// app link, which doesn't open in a browser.

features.name: Route planner
features.scope: Planner panel with start/stops/end, drag to reorder, remove, distance and time.
features.accept: Add start, two stops and end; reorder stops; the route rebuilds.
features.notes: Stop reordering fixed (5a65322); acceptance check not run yet.

features.name: Routing profiles
features.scope: Car, walk, bike, transit, ruler.
features.accept: Switch profile on the same points: route and time change.
features.notes: Transit depends on transit data in the maps; untested.

features.name: Avoid options
features.scope: Tolls, motorways, ferries, unpaved.
features.accept: Enable avoid tolls on a toll route: the route changes.

features.name: Defaults vs per-route options
features.scope: Settings hold defaults. Planner changes apply to the current route only.
features.accept: Change profile and avoid options in the planner, open Settings: defaults are unchanged.
features.notes: Planner rewrites global defaults; Settings caption claims otherwise.

features.name: Save route as track
features.scope: Save as Track creates a track in a chosen list.
features.accept: Save a route: a track with the same geometry appears in the library.

features.name: Route elevation profile
features.scope: Elevation chart and total ascent/descent for walk and bike routes in the planner.
features.accept: Plan a hiking route: the planner shows an elevation chart.
features.notes: Only saved tracks show elevation.

features.name: Turn-by-turn navigation
features.scope: Not offered on desktop.
features.notes: Decision D-02.

features.name: Lists, bookmarks and tracks
features.scope: Navigator panes: create, rename, delete lists; edit, move, delete items.
features.accept: Create a list, add a bookmark, move it to another list, delete the list.
features.notes: Lists and single items delete without confirmation or undo (R-S24). Stale-id aborts fixed (ebd5d77).

features.name: Metadata editing
features.scope: Edit name, description, color, list and tags for items; name and description for lists.
features.accept: Edit a bookmark's description, quit and relaunch: the edit persists.
features.notes: Cross-item save fixed (38632c7); acceptance check not run yet.

features.name: Sorting and views
features.scope: Sort by date, name, distance, length; group by type; tree or column view.
features.accept: Switch to column view and sort by length.

features.name: Type filter
features.scope: One-click All / Bookmarks / Tracks filter in the navigator.
features.accept: Choose Tracks: only tracks are listed.
features.notes: Only grouping and filter-builder conditions exist.

features.name: Import
features.scope: KML, KMZ, GPX, GeoJSON by menu, drag-and-drop, or folder; choose destination list, tag or project.
features.accept: Drop a folder of GPX files: each lands in the chosen list with its names intact.
features.notes: Import treats any list created during a batch as imported and may delete it (R-S4); a second batch's options are dropped. Multi-file drop race fixed (46db5fd).

features.name: Import keeps styling
features.scope: Import keeps the file's colors and line widths. Normalization is opt-in, never automatic.
features.accept: Import a GPX with a 2px blue track: it stays 2px and blue.
features.notes: Imports no longer rewrite track widths or colors (25a7503), and editing a track keeps its own color. Acceptance check not run yet. Re-check against upstream's custom bookmark colors on rebase.

features.name: Export
features.scope: Export a list, a selection, or a single track as KMZ, KML, GPX or GeoJSON.
features.accept: Export one track as GPX and open it in another app.
features.notes: List export works; single-track export has no UI.

features.name: Backup and restore
features.scope: Back up the whole library to one KMZ; restore by import.
features.accept: Back up, delete a list, import the backup: the list returns with tags.
features.notes: Restore path untested.

features.name: Track styling
features.scope: Color picker and stroke width for tracks.
features.accept: Change a track's width: map updates immediately.
features.notes: Color only, no width. A recolor is reverted by the next import, because SetColor leaves m_predefinedColor stale (R-B4).

features.name: Visibility
features.scope: Show or hide each item and each list on the map.
features.accept: Hide a track: it disappears from the map and stays hidden after relaunch.
features.notes: Bookmark visibility is runtime-only (Bookmark::SetIsVisible sets m_isVisible; KML saves m_data.m_visible), so hidden bookmarks reappear on relaunch. Tracks persist. Clear Filter rewrites every KML file (R-B10).

features.name: Multi-select and bulk actions
features.scope: Select many; move, color, tag, add to project, show/hide, delete; same right-click menu everywhere.
features.accept: Select 20 items and set their color at once.
features.notes: Bulk add-to-project is O(n^2) and saves once per item (R-S6).

features.name: Undo
features.scope: Cmd-Z undoes every library change, including deletes.
features.accept: Bulk-delete 5 items, press Cmd-Z: all 5 return.
features.notes: Deletes are not undoable.

features.name: Recently deleted
features.scope: Deleted lists go to a Recently Deleted area for 30 days, as on iOS.
features.accept: Delete a list, open Recently Deleted, restore it.

features.name: Quick Look
features.scope: Space or Cmd-Y previews the selected item with stats.
features.accept: Select a track, press Space: preview with distance and elevation.

features.name: Track statistics
features.scope: Distance, duration, ascent/descent and elevation chart for tracks, totals for selections.
features.accept: Select three tracks: totals add up.

features.name: Library search
features.scope: Search names, descriptions, tags and regions (Shift-Cmd-L).
features.accept: Search a tag name: tagged items appear.

features.name: Tags
features.scope: Finder-style tags on items, token editor with suggestions, stored in KML so they travel with the data.
features.accept: Tag an item, export its list, re-import: the tag is still there.
features.notes: project: tags show as ordinary tags; removing one silently drops project membership (R-S2).

features.name: Projects
features.scope: Projects group items across lists, with dates and an isolate mode.
features.accept: Create a project, add items from two lists, isolate it: only those items show.
features.notes: Project lists appear as normal lists in the navigator and every list picker (R-S2). Isolation state is lost if you quit while isolated (R-S3). Re-importing a backup may duplicate projects (R-S19, unverified).

features.name: Project itinerary
features.scope: Ordered day-by-day itinerary inside a project.
features.accept: Order project items into days.
features.notes: Data model exists (ItineraryEntry) but stores MarkIds, which change every launch; key entries by UUID. No UI.

features.name: Filter builder
features.scope: AND/OR conditions on name, type, color, list, tag, region, distance, length.
features.accept: Build 'tracks longer than 10 km tagged hike' and apply it.
features.notes: The default empty Name condition may hide everything on Apply (R-S9, unverified). Filter, isolation and Clear overwrite each other's visibility (R-S10).

features.name: Saved filters
features.scope: Save filters, apply from the Filter menu, Select Matching for bulk actions.
features.accept: Save a filter, relaunch, apply it from the menu.

features.name: Region attribution
features.scope: Items know which country/region they are in, used by filters and search.
features.accept: Filter by a region name: only items in it match.

features.name: Settings window
features.scope: Cmd-, opens tabbed Settings.
features.accept: Open Settings with Cmd-,.

features.name: Units, language, transliteration, large labels
features.scope: General tab.
features.accept: Change each and see the map update.

features.name: Bookmark label placement
features.scope: None, right or below.
features.accept: Switch to None: bookmark labels disappear.

features.name: Data folder
features.scope: One data folder for every build; move it with Change Location; copy or start fresh.
features.accept: Move the data folder to an external drive and relaunch: library intact.
features.notes: Debug and Release builds use different folders.

features.name: File logging
features.scope: Advanced toggle writes engine logs to a file you can attach to bug reports, with Reveal in Finder.
features.accept: Enable logging, reproduce an action, reveal the log file.
features.notes: Toggle is saved but nothing reads it.

features.name: Dropped mobile features
features.scope: OSM editing, donate, auto-download, power saving and compass calibration aren't offered.
features.notes: Decision D-02.

features.name: GPS track recording
features.scope: Decide: build it, or remove it from the README.
features.notes: README claims it; no code exists.

features.name: Universal binary
features.scope: Release runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel.
features.accept: lipo -info on the release binary lists arm64 and x86_64.
features.notes: Release builds arm64 only.

features.name: Signed and notarized
features.scope: Developer ID signature, hardened runtime, notarized and stapled.
features.accept: spctl -a -vv BDSM.app reports 'accepted, Notarized Developer ID'.
features.notes: Ad-hoc signed; no hardened runtime.

features.name: App identity
features.scope: Own bundle ID and name, version from one place, correct strings throughout.
features.accept: About window and Info.plist show the same version; no 'Organic Maps' product strings remain.
features.notes: Bundle ID is upstream's; version hard-coded in PlatformVersion.cpp.

features.name: In-app updates
features.scope: App checks for and installs new versions (Sparkle).
features.accept: An older build offers the newer release and installs it.

features.name: Accessibility
features.scope: VoiceOver labels on toolbar, navigator and inspector; full keyboard use.
features.accept: Navigate the library and inspector with VoiceOver only.
features.notes: Not audited.

features.name: Large-library performance
features.scope: A 5,000-item library opens, scrolls, filters and bulk-edits without visible lag.
features.accept: Import the 5k-item fixture: navigator scroll and filter stay smooth.
features.notes: Untested. Table view rebuilds and re-sorts the whole library on every click (R-S5); maps manager walks the full country tree on each progress tick (R-B11).
